product.title: Monterey Whale Watching Tour

description.text: Join a Monterey whale-watching cruise aboard a comfortable vessel with onboard naturalists and marine biologists. The route explores Monterey Bay sanctuary waters to spot humpback, gray, and blue whales along with dolphins, sea otters, and other Pacific wildlife.

highlights: Comfortable vessel designed for wildlife viewing
High success rate for seasonal whale sightings
Marine biologist commentary on Monterey Bay ecology

start.description: Meet at the Monterey waterfront departure point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Return to the Monterey departure pier after the cruise.
